contexto: We compare our neural approach to scientific document classification and citation recommendation with TARGETCIT.
titulo: Neural representations for scientific document classification
abstract: This invented example describes a neural approach to representing scientific documents for classification and citation recommendation. It is a synthetic software test and makes no empirical performance claim.
